candidates.description: The feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi and Indian-language scripts as well as English text processing artifacts.
This vector activates for Hindi vowel matras, suffixes, and character fragments.
These tokens represent common character combinations and vowel-consonant ligatures from the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.
These tokens represent common Hindi word endings and suffixes, primarily functioning as noun-forming or verb-inflecting morphological components.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments in Devanagari script alongside miscellaneous numbers.
These tokens represent inflectional suffixes and root morphemes characteristic of Hindi verb conjugation and grammatical gender/number agreement.
These tokens represent a collection of various Hindi characters, consonant clusters, and vowel signs in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel matras and punctuation marks used in text formatting.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters, conjuncts, and sub-syllabic text fragments commonly found in Hindi or Sanskrit tokenization.
This vector activates on characters, syllables, and words written in the Devanagari script.
